scope: square-okhttp only. kevinsawicki (15 tests) and tootallnate (23) are entirely flaky, so a two-class index exists for one project. NOT comparable to precomputed/retrieval-eval.json (17 projects).

shipped_component.name: MessageLookup
shipped_component.method: exact failure-message lookup, abstains on unseen
shipped_component.why: identical accuracy to MiniLM embeddings, no model, no index, no staleness

cross_project.reason: Holding out square-okhttp leaves an index of 38 tests that are entirely flaky -- a single-class index, which the observer refuses. Holding out either other project leaves a single-class QUERY set, so precision@k is 1.0 regardless of what retrieval does. Both directions measure class composition, not retrieval.

conclusion: Retrieval works and is redundant. MiniLM embeddings + 5-NN score 0.9851 against a 0.5050 majority baseline -- and a single substring check scores 0.9851, identically. 100 of 102 deterministic tests share one failure message, so the task has one decision boundary that every method finds. The exact-message lookup ships; retrieval is recorded as tested and redundant.
